title: Most beautiful sunrise we have ever seen.
text: This was absolutely one of the most beautiful sunrises we have ever experienced.  It was also nice to beat the crowds. Craig, our guide, was really great. He was knowledgeable and pointed out all the beautiful history and artwork. Craig took us to a nice little restaurant in Marganell, a nearby town. At Cal Jaume we enjoyed a Catalan brunch and met the owners. We also tried their Ratafia and Gin.  We brought a bottle of each to bring home.  Craig also made recommendations for our dinner in Barcelona and helped us get into a great place for that evening.  Thanks Craig for an enjoyable tour and
author: barbaramA2175UV
